author: Alice
content: Good morning team! Let's sync on the v2.0 release planned for October 15.

author: Bob
content: Hey Alice. We hit a major blocker yesterday. The PaymentService is failing during checkout with HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout.

author: Charlie
content: I looked into the PaymentService logs. It turns out PaymentService depends on the AuthDB connection pool, which is getting exhausted during peak traffic.

author: Alice
content: Thanks Charlie. Who is assigned to fix the AuthDB pool issue?

author: Charlie
content: I assigned Dave to fix the AuthDB pool sizing issue (Ticket #BUG-402). He's increasing max connections from 20 to 100.

author: Dave
content: Update on #BUG-402: I deployed the config change to staging. AuthDB max connections is now 100, and PaymentService 504 errors are completely resolved.

author: Alice
content: Awesome work Dave! Now regarding frontend: Eve, did we decide on using TailwindCSS or Vanilla CSS for the customer portal redesign?

author: Eve
content: After discussion with design, we decided on TailwindCSS v3.4 for the portal. It will speed up component building.

author: Bob
content: Also a reminder for security: Frank is setting up Presidio PII redaction on all customer chat exports before we send them to external LLMs.

author: Frank
content: Yes, Presidio will redact credit card numbers and SSNs. Ticket #SEC-109 is currently in review by Alice.

author: Alice
content: Approved #SEC-109! Great work everyone. Target launch date is confirmed for October 15.
